resources.string: Reads the permission and AppOps state of every package in the chosen group and reports what VOID could not read or understand. Nothing is changed. A large group takes several minutes; Stop keeps the partial report. Leaving this screen stops the check.

Results depend on the device and the ROM. Vendor system apps (for example Security on Xiaomi HyperOS or MIUI, or Samsung and other OEM apps) behave differently on every device, and some changes are silently refused by the platform. If this report shows errors or unrecognised lines, or a change is refused on your device, please open a GitHub issue with the report so the parser and guards can be adapted to your ROM.
